message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and importance as international hubs:

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and Latin America; home to many international carriers. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; major hub for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Large hub for American Airlines; extensive domestic and international connections. |
| Denver International Airport (DEN) | Denver, CO | DEN | Known for its distinctive peaked roof; hub for United and Southwest Airlines. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) | New York City, NY | JFK | Major hub for American Airlines and Delta; primary gateway to Europe and the Caribbean. |
| San Francisco International Airport (SFO) | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Hub for United Airlines; key gateway to Asia and the Pacific Rim. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport (SEA) | Seattle, WA | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for Delta; strong Asian connections. |
| Miami International Airport (MIA) | Miami, FL | MIA | Major hub for American Airlines; primary gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| Orlando International Airport (MCO) | Orlando, FL | MCO | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; high volume of leisure travelers. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Hub for American Airlines; significant domestic traffic. |
| George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) | Houston, TX | IAH | Major hub for United Airlines; strong international presence. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT) | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports in the U.S. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) | Washington, DC | IAD | Hub for United Airlines; important for government and diplomatic travel. |

These airports serve as major gateways for both domestic and international flights, handling millions of passengers each year and acting as hubs for several major airlines.
